How I work

Beyond the dashboard.

A cheap lead in Ads Manager means nothing if it never turns into a profitable sale. Before I scale a budget, I audit the business behind the ads. Each step links to a screenshot that shows it.

  1. 01

    Tracking & data truth

    Pixel, Conversions API, GTM and GA4 set up so Ads Manager matches what the store actually sold. Every decision after this depends on clean data.

  2. 02

    Unit economics

    Margin per product, break-even ROAS and target CPA calculated before launch, so I know what a purchase can afford to cost.

  3. 03

    Market & customer

    Competitors' products, prices, offers and angles. Then the customer: who buys, why, and which objections stop them. That is where creative angles come from.

    ↓7 markets, 20+ niches
  4. 04

    Offer & product focus

    Budget goes behind the most profitable products, not just the best sellers, with offers built to lift order value: bundles, thresholds, limited-time deals.

  5. 05

    Full-funnel gaps

    Ad, landing page, product page, checkout and repeat purchase. I find where buyers drop off, because fixing that grows sales faster than adding spend.

  6. 06

    Launch, test, scale on profit

    Structured creative tests on hooks and angles, then scaling on net profit and real outcomes like site visits, not platform ROAS. Reviewed every week.
